name: Hydsoft Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hydsoft Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the provision of professional information technology (IT) services in China and internationally. The company offers cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, and mobile Internet; and technical consulting, overall architecture, requirements analysis, system design, system development, and testing and maintenance services. The company also provides consulting and technical support services; and digital operation services, including digital transformation consulting, big data platform construction, full-chain data governance, data asset and data intelligence analysis services, large-scale intelligent agents, SAP implementation…
